newsitem.title: POLAND: Exbud to buy bridge construction firm.
newsitem.headline: Exbud to buy bridge construction firm.

text.p: Polish construction firm Exbud SA signed an agreement to buy a 46.15 percent stake in the bridge construction firm Kieleckie Przedsiebiorstwo Robot Mostowych SA (KPRM) later this year, a senior Exbud official said.

Dariusz Soltysik told Reuters that after the purchase, Exbud would further increse its stake in KPRM, which is the biggest bridge construction firm in Poland to majority, but declined to give any details. @

"We have signed an agreement with KPRM, which provides for KPRM to issue new shares, which will be bought by Exbud by the end of the year," he said, but did not reveal the value of the planned transaction.
Soltysik said KPRM, which employs 1,100 people, expected to have sales of 65 million zlotys in 1996, but declined to give any comparative figures.
